title: GAWD Manifest
description: The GAWD creature contract at rest / in transit: the sole metadata + permission source for a creature. Maintained and drift-guarded against the `sigil::Manifest` Rust type by cosmos/sigil/tests/manifest_schema.rs. See cosmos/sigil/README.md for prose and a minimal valid manifest per tier.
$comment: maxLength/maxItems mirror sigil's MAX_MANIFEST_* caps. The node enforces string limits in UTF-8 BYTES while JSON Schema maxLength counts code points, so a multibyte string can be refused by the node even when it satisfies maxLength here — treat the numbers as byte budgets.

entrypoints.description: Advertised typed entries the creature exposes (e.g. `handle`).

content_address.description: `sha256:<hex>` over the manifest's identity shape. Set by the producer and re-derived + asserted by admission. Null/absent before it is stamped.

provides.description: Which inversion-of-control roles this creature can fill (e.g. `["distributor", "policy"]`).

Abi.description: The entry-boundary descriptor: which engine, what compatibility tag, what targets.

backend.description: The execution tier. `daemon` = native .so (trusted-by-admission); `beast` = WASM (sandboxed); `critter` = Rhai script (metered + sandboxed).

abi_tag.description: Entry-boundary compatibility tag. `gawd_creature_v1` for daemon and beast; `gawd_critter_v1` for critter.

target.description: Opaque target labels (arch-os triples, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, robot/satellite/edge embodiments). The fabric assigns no meaning; an injected matcher weighs them. Empty = unspecified/portable.

Entrypoint.description: A typed entry the creature exposes.

name.description: Entry name, e.g. `handle`. Non-empty; unique within the manifest.

signature.description: Legacy human-readable typed descriptor, e.g. `(Envelope) -> Outcome`. Non-empty.

EntrypointContractV1.description: Optional machine-readable function contract. Draft 2020-12 schemas describe application JSON multiplexed through the existing creature handle ABI.

SchemaRefV1.description: A bounded inline Draft 2020-12 schema or a content-addressed external schema. Variant shape is also enforced by Rust serde/validation.

Capabilities.description: Bus-level + resource capabilities. Enforced only when an operator opts in.

fs.description: Filesystem paths the creature may touch.

net.description: Declared network reach. `none` is the safe default.

calls.description: Which addresses / intents / roles this creature may send to. Empty = unrestricted (dev default).

budget_warn_at.description: Opt-in advisory threshold: emit a budget Warn after a successful handle once the consumed fraction of cpu_ms/mem_bytes crosses this percent. Intended range 0..=100; values >100 are clamped at engine load. Absent = no Warn ever fires.

wall_ms.description: Opt-in per-envelope wall-clock cap (ms). A beast that exceeds this in one handle traps with a Hard Wall budget signal (enforced via wasmtime epoch interruption). Critter/daemon tiers do not enforce it. Absent = unlimited.

Requirements.description: What a host must offer for this creature to run. The Distributor matches these against a node's advertised embodiment.

Provenance.description: Authorship + integrity. `author` is the Abode key (the distributed self), not the node key. Verification is a mechanism; which roots to trust is injected policy.

author.description: The Abode public key (authorship identity), encoded.

signature.description: Signature over the signing payload (the manifest with `signature` cleared). Set `content_address` BEFORE signing — it rides inside the signature.

realm.description: Optional Realm the author asserts this creature belongs to. Signed alongside the rest. Absent = no claim.
